issues.on_page: Operating expenses of an irrigation district (Mileage ... Depreciation)
issues.issue: All 18 expense lines (disbursements[0]-[17]) use function 'utilities'. The disbursement category rules list water and drainage districts under 'natural resources/conservation', which may fit an irrigation district better. A judgment call.
This is an irrigation district, not a public power district. The entity type label may be wrong.
